state.task: User asks any-day extra practice entrances for HRP, Plank, two-mile running. Judge this feature only, not overall whole product.
state.implementation: Train tab offers three buttons below main plan, bypasses weekly rotation and full ten-movement warmup with concise own-warmup note. HRP120sec selfcount, Plankelapsed timer, two-mile externallytimed result input. Existing workout/Boss prevents overwrite. Help pauses timedsessions; close retains paused state; reload restores checkpoint; runhelp retains enteredtime. Practice only explicitly appends standard PR record, no daily session/coursecompletion/XP/streak or rotationchange. Cancel discardsdraft; practice result returns to training. Old Boss checkpoints lacking practice flag retain old behavior. Save-failure journal preserves idempotence. Raw PR entries use same existing format; no per-set routine builder or GPS running tracker.
state.validation: Independent browser QA and code audit cover real DOM routes, any-day selectors, partial inputs, cancel/guard, timer/help/reload, save failure/doubleclick, no session or XP mutation; old Boss flow regression. Complete repository CI and live deployment are separate gates, do not infer them complete. No user study or real iPhone OS-eviction verification.
state.limitations: PR-only practice counts as recorded score for existing progress summaries but does not mark daily workout complete. User-requested entry feature scope; no full adjustable training-program editor.
